# authwise_endpoint_auth (Data Source)

The credential kit presents on every call to an endpoint, resolved at call time so a secret's new version takes effect without touching the endpoint. Builds the EndpointAuth message and exposes its protojson encoding as `json`, the value `authwise_endpoint.auth` takes. Makes no API calls.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Exactly one of bearer, basic, header and kit_token.
data "authwise_endpoint_auth" "this" {
  bearer = {
    token = { name = authwise_secret.risk_token.name }
  }
}

resource "authwise_endpoint" "this" {
  display_name = "Risk service"
  address      = "https://risk.example.com/v1"
  auth         = data.authwise_endpoint_auth.this.json
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `basic` (Attributes) Sends `authorization: Basic …`. At most one of `bearer`, `basic`, `header`, `kit_token` may be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--basic))
- `bearer` (Attributes) Sends `authorization: Bearer <token>`. At most one of `bearer`, `basic`, `header`, `kit_token` may be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bearer))
- `header` (Attributes) Sends `<name>: <value>`, an API-key header. At most one of `bearer`, `basic`, `header`, `kit_token` may be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--header))
- `kit_token` (Attributes) Sends `authorization: Bearer <token>`, where the token is an access token kit signs from `issuer` for each call. No secret is stored. At most one of `bearer`, `basic`, `header`, `kit_token` may be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kit_token))

### Read-Only

- `json` (String) The protojson encoding of EndpointAuth, for `authwise_endpoint.auth`.
